input.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page is a long dark table full of percentages and companies I don't know, so I'll ask you, and maybe the bank, before I move a shekel. The only thing that caught my eye was a button saying "אג"ח ממשלתי". Government bonds I know are safe, so that's what I'd ask about.

stuck.where: First screen, the rows of buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: Too many buttons with words I don't know (עוקב מדד, s&p 500, גמיש, סחיר). Nothing says which one is safe like a deposit.
Every row has two fee numbers, two percentages next to a little coloured circle, two returns and a huge sum. I couldn't tell which column matters for me, and the circles mean nothing to me.

stuck.where: The company names in the table (מור, אנליסט, מיטב)
stuck.why: None of them is my bank. I don't know these companies and wouldn't hand them our savings.

stuck.where: "פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a return
stuck.why: I didn't understand whether that means the track is new or that it lost money.

used: The title "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the line saying fees are what was actually charged in 2025
The filter buttons, especially "אג"ח ממשלתי סחיר 1" and "אג"ח ממשלתית 3"
The fee column "דמי ניהול ... מהחיסכון": about 0.54% to 0.73%
Group headers with company names: מור, אנליסט, מיטב
skimmed: The columns "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח" with the coloured circles
The returns column "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול"
Screens 3–5 of the table, mostly just the track names on the right
skipped: Screens 6 to 15. I was too tired and stopped at the fifth one
The "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link (in pale green, didn't open it)
The small grey line under the buttons about how companies are ordered
The tabs at the top: מדריך, חוקים וכללים, שאלות שכולם שואלים
unsure_meaning: s&p 500 / S&P500, letter by letter
עוקב מדד, מדדים גמיש
סחיר
מט"ח
הלכה יהודית as an investment
כספי (שקלי). Is that like money in the bank?
מהחיסכון vs מההפקדות (two kinds of fee?)
"פחות מ־3 שנים" shown in place of a return
Numbers above 100%, like 101% מניות
The dotted underlines and little clock icons next to every number
The coloured rings (teal and yellow look alike to me)
"123 מקור / מחושב / הזנתה" near the top
not_found: Anything about deposits or something as safe as a פיקדון
My bank or any big bank's name
A plain sentence saying which track is safe or low-risk
An explanation of what I'd actually get on 400,000 ₪

findings.what: Dark black background with grey and coloured small text. Hard on my eyes, even enlarged.
The page opens with shares, indexes and English letters, nothing about safe saving, so it feels like it's not meant for me
Each row is packed with about eight numbers. It made me anxious and I couldn't tell what to compare.
Companies I've never heard of. My bank isn't there.
Small pale grey text I couldn't read properly
findings.where: Line under the filter buttons; column headers

findings.what: Yellow warning box saying data wasn't updated since September 2026, so I'm not sure it's current
The coloured circles for shares and מט"ח are close in colour. I couldn't tell them apart.
Some returns are missing and replaced by "פחות מ־3 שנים" with no explanation
